image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a crocodile's head partially submerged in murky water. The image focuses on the textured, armored skin of the snout and the dorsal surface of the head, with one eye clearly visible above the waterline. Water droplets are suspended in the air near the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the snout tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and the jawline is submerged or obscured by the angle; teeth are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned on top of the head. While the vertical slit pupil is difficult to resolve at this resolution, the dorsal positioning and general morphology are correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly visible at the anterior tip of the snout, raised slightly above the water level.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and upper neck are visible; the full body length cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture on the head and neck shows distinct, rough, bony ridges and scales consistent with osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of muddy browns and greys, and the texture is visibly rough and granular.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the animal is completely submerged and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the field of view.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'African crocodile' class. All testable checkpoints regarding head morphology, snout shape, eye position, and skin texture are passed. Several checkpoints were untestable due to the tight cropping (body, limbs, tail), but there are no contradictions in the visible data. The high score reflects perfect conformance of visible features.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts detected. The water physics (droplets and ripples) appear natural, the depth of field is consistent with a telephoto lens, and the skin texture is detailed without signs of melting, smearing, or structural collapse.
